adversarial_checklist.modular_controls: PASS: self, product-lift equality, canonical/recursive controls, and 74-pair detection

lemmas.finite_field: For phi: Z[t2,t3]^4 -> F_p^4, phi(P)!=phi(Q) implies P!=Q.
lemmas.projection: Psi_{<=2}=pi_{<=2} o Psi_{<=3}; therefore Psi_{<=3} refines Psi_{<=2}.

recurrence_operation_audit.branch_combination: PASS: modular sum of left_value*right_value, the image of exact convolution.
recurrence_operation_audit.convolution_products: PASS: exponent addition maps to multiplication of monomial values and phi preserves products.
recurrence_operation_audit.diagonal_code_and_branch_enumeration: PASS: finite, coefficient-independent index enumerations; phi commutes termwise with their sums.
recurrence_operation_audit.substitutions_or_division: PASS: none are used by the Psi3 recurrence.
recurrence_operation_audit.tuple_shifts_and_reindexing: PASS: shifts only select recursive subproblems and introduce no coefficient operation.
